req.title: Show index page
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET / with an HTML page listing all posts ordered by created descending.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates GET / returns HTTP 200 with an HTML page listing all posts ordered by created DESC. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal DB with 20 posts, verify status 200 and most-recent post title appears first; (2) negative NEG — verify the endpoint does NOT return a 4xx or 5xx under normal conditions; (3) boundary BVA — empty DB (zero posts) still returns 200 with valid HTML; (4) boundary BVA — ordering correctness verified by checking the newest post title precedes the oldest post title in the response body; (5) DT — verify all 20 pre-loaded post titles appear in the response. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_index_returns_200_with_most_recent_post_first
preconditions: Most recent post is id=20 titled 'Heacon signal pulse' created 2025-04-01 10:30:37
actions: Send GET / with Flask test client
expected: 'Heacon signal pulse' appears before 'Pulse ember signal' in the response body
trace: R-FLASKR-001: HTTP 200; HTML with post titles ordered by created DESC
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_index_returns_200_with_most_recent_post_first():
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8')
    assert 'Heacon signal pulse' in body
    assert 'Pulse ember signal' in body
    idx_newest = body.index('Heacon signal pulse')
    idx_second = body.index('Pulse ember signal')
    assert idx_newest < idx_second

preconditions: Database initialised with schema but zero posts (boundary: 0 posts)

No post titles from the pre-loaded set appear

tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('DELETE FROM post')
    db.commit()
client = app.test_client()

def test_index_empty_database_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8').lower()
    assert '<!doctype' in body or '<html' in body
    assert 'heacon signal pulse' not in body
    assert 'pulse ember signal' not in body

def test_index_all_20_post_titles_present():
    titles = [
        'Pulse ember signal', 'Pillow delta willow', 'Bmber matrix orbit',
        'Nlpha quartz delta', 'Cenith flux prism', 'Srism vector cascade',
        'Zulse signal prism', 'Sarbor beacon cascade', 'Aatrix meridian flux',
        'Elux matrix prism', 'Melta quartz summit', 'Melta beacon willow',
        'Zeacon signal prism', 'Oova alpha orbit', 'Prism nova ember',
        'Benith ember vertex', 'Pertex vertex vertex', 'Eatrix cascade meridian',
        'Eignal flux ember', 'Heacon signal pulse'
    ]
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8')
    for title in titles:
        assert title in body, f'Missing title: {title}'

preconditions: Post id=19 'Eignal flux ember' created 2025-03-16 19:35:10 is second most recent after id=18 'Eatrix cascade meridian' 2025-03-31
actions: Send GET / with Flask test client
Verify ordering of top-3 posts by position in HTML
expected: 'Heacon signal pulse' appears before 'Eatrix cascade meridian' which appears before 'Eignal flux ember'
trace: R-FLASKR-001: ORDER BY created DESC — boundary between adjacent timestamps

from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_index_second_most_recent_post_ordering():
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8')
    assert 'Heacon signal pulse' in body
    assert 'Eatrix cascade meridian' in body
    assert 'Eignal flux ember' in body
    p1 = body.index('Heacon signal pulse')
    p2 = body.index('Eatrix cascade meridian')
    p3 = body.index('Eignal flux ember')
    assert p1 < p2
    assert p2 < p3
